senses.gloss:
__1 The Indian crane; न प्रयत्नशतेनापि शुकवत् पाठ्यते बकः [[H.]] 
__2 A cheat, rogue, hypocrite (the crane being a very cunning bird that knows well how to draw others into its clutches). 
__3 N. of a demon killed by Bhīma. 
__4 N. of another demon killed by Kṛṣṇa. 
__5 N. of Kubera. 6 An apparatus for subliming metals or minerals. 
-की = पूतना q. v. अहो बकी यं स्तनकालकूटं जिघांसयापाययदप्यसाध्वी [[Bhāg. 3. 2. 23.]] 
__2 A female crane. 
-Comp. 
-चरः, -वृत्तिः, -व्रतचरः, -व्रतिकः, -व्रतिन् m. ‘acting like a crane’, a false devotee, religious hypocrite; अधोदृष्टिर्नैष्कृतिकः स्वार्थसाधनतत्परः । शठो मिथ्याबिनीतश्च बकव्रतचरो द्विजः ॥ [[Ms. 4. 196.]] 
-चिञ्चिका, -चिञ्ची a kind of fish. 
-जित् m., 
-निषूदनः epithets of 
__1 Bhīma. 
__2 of Kṛṣṇa. 
-धूपः a kind of perfume. 
-पञ्चकम् the last five days of the bright half of the month of Kārtika (during which even the heron eats no fish). 
-यन्त्रम् a kind of retort. 
-व्रतम् ‘crane-like conduct’, hypocrisy; ये बकव्रतिनो विप्राः [[Ms. 4. 197]]; see also 196 (बकव्रतचर). 
-सहवासिन् a lotus flower; [[Kuval.]]
Denom. P. To act like बक.

a. Horrible. 
-रः 
__1 Lightning; thunderbolt. 
__2 A wind instrument used in battle; अभि दस्युं बकुरेणा धमन्ता [[Rv. 1. 117. 21.]] (Naighaṇtuka gives the first meaning.)

__1 A kind of tree, Mimusops Elengi, (said according to the convention of poets to put forth blossoms when sprinkled by young women with mouthfuls of wine); काङ्क्षत्यन्यो (केसरः or बकुलः) वदनमादिरां दोहदच्छद्यनाऽस्याः [[Me. 80]]; बकुलः सीधुगण्डूषसेकात् (विकसति); तब निश्वसितानुकारिर्भिर्बकुलैरर्धचितां समं मया [[R. 8. 64]]; (for similar conventions about other trees see the quotation [Page1149-2] under अशोक). 
__2 A kind of drug. 
-लम् The fragrant flower of this tree; कृती मालाकारो बकुलमपि कुत्रापि निदधे [[Bv. 1. 54.]] 
-ली A kind of drug.

__1 A small crane. 
__2 The branch of a tree bent by the wind.
The fruit of the Bakula tree.
